::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses"}
#docs
## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.usage_close_delay_minutes` | `integer` | Extra minutes before a period's usage closes, for apps that buffer events. Usage closes about 6 minutes after the period ends plus this wait, never more than 30 minutes. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `data.name` | `string` | The business's name. |
| `data.livemode` | `string` | `live` for a live business, `test` for a test business. One of `live`, `test`. |
| `data.live_business_id` | `string` | On a test business: the id of its live mode. Null on a live business. |
| `data.test_business_id` | `string` | On a live business: the id of its test mode. Null until test mode is first opened for a business created before test modes existed — POST /v1/businesses/{biz}/test_mode creates it. |
| `data.default_currency` | `string` | The business's default currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.currencies` | `array of string` | Currencies this business transacts in; null = unrestricted. |
| `data.exchange_rates` | `object` | The raw rate map: 1 default_currency = rate × key currency. Kept as numbers for the consumers that already read it; `currency_rates` below is the same rates with their provenance and is the one to prefer. |
| `data.currency_rates` | `array of object` | Per-currency rate + provenance (one row per configured currency, excluding the business's own default, which is 1 by definition). This is what a currency-settings screen needs: whether the rate is maintained by hand or refreshed from a provider, when the rate being held was PUBLISHED, and why the last refresh failed if it did. |
| `data.week_start` | `string` | First day of the reporting week. Default `sunday`. One of `sunday`, `monday`. |
| `data.fiscal_year_start_month` | `integer` | Month (1–12) the fiscal year starts in; default 1 (the calendar year). Fiscal years are named by the year they end in. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The business's status. |
| `data.portal_field_config` | `object` | The buyer portal's field matrix, resolved: every key present, tax-locked keys already mandatory. |
| `data.address_field_locks` | `object` | Address keys the business's live tax setup forces to mandatory on checkout and portal. The settings refuse any other state for them. |
| `data.team_alerts_config` | `object` | Team alerts. Each alert sends only when it is enabled and `recipients` has at least one address. Mail comes from the platform sender, not from the business mail settings. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the business was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
